# Specific time beats apology

`customer_support.heu.de_escalation.specific_time_beats_apology` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> A specific next time beats a sincere apology.


## The heuristic

**A specific next time beats a sincere apology.**


_Why:_ Apology asks for trust in our feelings; a time asks for trust in our calendar, and only the second is checkable. A customer who has been let down has stopped extending the first kind of credit and will still extend the second, once.
